id: \bGround types are a bad choice against Skyla.
en: \bGround types are a bad choice against Skyla.
it: \bI tipi Terra sono una pessima scelta contro Anemone.

id: \bThe gym was made simple after Skyla spent less time battling in it.
en: \bThe gym was made simple after Skyla spent less time battling in it.
it: \bLa palestra è stata semplificata da quando Anemone ci lotta meno.

id: \rSkyla: You hold enough promise. You better prove my Air Battle wrong.
en: \rSkyla: You hold enough promise. You better prove my Air Battle wrong.
it: \rAnemone: Sei abbastanza promettente. Vedi di smentire la mia Lotta Aerea.

id: \rSkyla: I don't believe it. You actually beat me. Even though my Air Battle said you would lose. I guess Air Battles are not perfect.
en: \rSkyla: I don't believe it. You actually beat me. Even though my Air Battle said you would lose. I guess Air Battles are not perfect.
it: \rAnemone: Non ci credo. Mi hai battuta davvero. Eppure la mia Lotta Aerea diceva che avresti perso. Forse le Lotte Aeree non sono perfette.

id: \rTM62 contains Acrobatics. It does more damage if you are not holding an item.
en: \rTM62 contains Acrobatics. It does more damage if you are not holding an item.
it: \rLa MT62 contiene Acrobazia. Infligge più danni se non tieni nessuno strumento.

id: \rSkyla: From now on I'm going to do traditional battles. That's the best way to judge a Trainer.
en: \rSkyla: From now on I'm going to do traditional battles. That's the best way to judge a Trainer.
it: \rAnemone: D'ora in poi farò lotte tradizionali. È il modo migliore per giudicare un Allenatore.

id: \bSkyla uses Flying type Pokémon. They are weak aganst Electric, Ice, and Rock types.
en: \bSkyla uses Flying type Pokémon. They are weak aganst Electric, Ice, and Rock types.
it: \bAnemone usa Pokémon di tipo Volante. Sono deboli contro i tipi Elettro, Ghiaccio e Roccia.

id: \bThey are strong against Bug, Grass, and Fighting. Those types also don't do much damage. They are immune to Ground types as well.
en: \bThey are strong against Bug, Grass, and Fighting.  Those types also don't do much damage. They are immune to Ground types as well.
it: \bSono forti contro Coleottero, Erba e Lotta. Anche questi tipi non fanno molti danni. In più sono immuni al tipo Terra.

id: \bYou must be good to challenge Skyla.
en: \bYou must be good to challenge Skyla.

id: \bAn Electric type will wipe Skyla out.
en: \bAn Electric type will wipe Skyla out.
